newsitem.title: UK: BSG conditionally agrees 72 mln stg disposal.
newsitem.headline: BSG conditionally agrees 72 mln stg disposal.

text.p: BSG International Plc, a motor dealer and components maker, said it had conditionally agreed to sell its subsidiary Bristol Street Companies to Brismoco for around 72 million stg.

The disposal reduces the BSG's exposure to the car dealership sector and is in line with its strategy to separate Britax and Bristol Street to focus resources on the international development of Britax's businesses.
BSG proposes to change the company's name to Britax International Plc at its AGM in May.
The sale is conditional on shareholders' approval.
Brismoco is a new company under the management of the existing Bristol Street team and backed by Legal & General Ventures.

The announcement accompanied BSG's annual results which showed pre-tax profit before exceptionals for the year to December 31, 1996, up 43 percent at 36.7 million stg. A total dividend is proposed for the year of 3.52 pence per share, up 10 percent.
